summary: Completed testing of TRON bridge support with Rhino-style ingress. Backend APIs (create, estimate, status) all working correctly. Frontend token selection modal has chain icons, View all, and search features. UI bug found: selecting TRON chain from 'View all' modal doesn't properly close modal and show TRON tokens.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking TRON chain in 'View all' modal doesn't close the modal and return to token list. The nested Dialog components have interaction issues.
ui_bugs.note: Users cannot select native TRON chain tokens (TRX, USDT on TRON) through the UI. They can only select wrapped TRX on Ethereum.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot select native TRON chain tokens due to ViewAllChainsModal not closing properly

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/tron/swap/create returns order_id and deposit_address (TRON address format)
Backend: POST /api/tron/swap/estimate returns steps array with SunSwap, Allbridge, LI.FI
Backend: GET /api/tron/swap/{id} returns order status with progress percentage
Backend: LI.FI chains and tokens endpoints working
Frontend: App name is 'Swap' (not CrossSwap) in header, hero, footer
Frontend: Token selection modal opens with chain icons
Frontend: 'View all' button shows all chains including TRON
Frontend: Search functionality works in token modal
Frontend: TRON chain visible in 'Select Chain' modal with red icon
failed_tests: Frontend: Selecting TRON chain from 'View all' modal - modal doesn't close
Frontend: Cannot verify 'TRON Bridge Route' info box (requires native TRON token selection)
Frontend: Cannot verify purple gradient button styling (requires native TRON token selection)
action_items: Fix ViewAllChainsModal: clicking a chain should close the modal and update activeChain in parent TokenSelectModal
Verify TRON Bridge Route info box appears when native TRON token is selected (after modal fix)
Verify purple gradient button styling for TRON swaps (after modal fix)
critical_code_review_comments: ViewAllChainsModal nested Dialog issue: The onClick handler calls onSelect(c.id) and onClose() but the modal doesn't close. This may be due to nested Radix Dialog components conflicting.
Consider using a single Dialog with conditional content instead of nested Dialogs

success_rate.frontend: 70% (7/10 features verified, 3 blocked by modal bug)
